title: Nadir M NDE 964
content:
Please, I want to describe my NDE here. It occurred in 1994, I was with my friends in a car of one of them, and we were supporting the Saudian football team for reaching the world cup mondial. We rode in the car and I had a feeling that someone was observing me all the time, my friend was driving at a mad speed. I was in the back seat near the door, I was holding the flag of Saudi Arabia and the slogan of the team, and I was sitting in the doorway of the car (my upper body was out of the car). My friend lost the control of the car. Then I saw something like a fantasy. I looked behind, I saw the lamb of the street, and I was going to it very quickly. I entered the car quickly, and then the story began. I felt that I am so tall, with no weight, out of control. I saw everything of my past life, since my birth. I saw it as if I watch it, then everything disappeared. I was walking, but the step in a width of ten steps. When I turned my face to left or right, I saw persons; some of them observing me, the others were looking at me as if they are waiting for something from me. Others were looking at each other. I saw many people whom I had mistreated or hurt, they were looking at me as if they wanted to take revenge. Then I stopped without my wish, as if there was a sign of compulsory (STOP), though there is a long road to another world in front of me (the end). I didn't reach it yet. I was so frightened without my heart beating! Then I felt that my body was so cold, I don't know why at that time. Then I felt as if I was falling from a high cliff, I didn't feel the crash in the ground, everything was dark. Then I felt that I have a body, I stood up, then I felt that my body was turning and hit on hard thing in the left and right. Then I fell on the ground, it was very cold. Then I stood up and I saw a light and a face of some man. The man looked at me and escaped, like there was a lion running after him. Do you know who was that man? He was the man who is responsible for burying the dead; I was out of the fridge. The time? It was timeless, some hours finished as if minutes, and minutes ran as hour. And now here are the information I knew from the people after recovery: I was dead for about thirteen hours; I was out of the fridge, the time until the people came to me about one hour and twenty-five minutes, though I thought it was minutes. I was very amazed by the time differences. I can't describe the body health in good medical way. Do you want to know what happens during the death?! Believe me, you will not know at all. Finally, I thank you for this opportunity and letting me tell you my story with death, it calmed me down a lot. I forgot to tell you that all the people who were sitting right and left of me were people who were asking me their rights.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt "so tall, with no weight, out of control."

arrival.other_being_detail: He later saw "a light and a face of some man" identified as "the man who is responsible for burying the dead."

environment.environment_other_detail: A long road "to another world"; later "everything was dark."

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Described as "falling from a high cliff" into darkness, then regaining a body and impacting hard surfaces.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Car accident (friend driving fast, lost control).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: A crowd of people he had "mistreated or hurt" who were "asking me their rights" / seeming to want revenge; later seeing the mortuary worker after return.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Life review occurred early; then walking on a road with people on both sides; then an enforced stop/boundary; then falling into darkness and returning to the body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Reported being dead about thirteen hours and being in a morgue fridge; saw the mortuary worker who "escaped" after seeing him. Also described people on both sides "asking me their rights" and a compulsory STOP sign-like barrier.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I saw everything of my past life, since my birth."; "Then I stopped without my wish, as if there was a sign of compulsory (STOP)."; "I was dead for about thirteen hours; I was out of the fridge."; "The time? It was timeless, some hours finished as if minutes, and minutes ran as hour."
